result.rationale: The diff lowercases only blacklist entries (`.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`) while `guests` values are compared as-is: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` and `!blacklistedGuests.includes(guest)`. Since the Zod schema (`z.string().email()`) does not normalize case, 'User@Example.com' bypasses a blacklist entry 'user@example.com' and duplicates an existing attendee stored in different case, being added anyway. Mechanism is verifiable in the diff.
